title: Trepan
summary: A simple shortsword carried by Sister Clara.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, one-handed, Finesse and Light. 5 ft melee. Hit for 1d6 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity.
fields.Nurse effect: When wielded by a nurse, adds 1d6 Necrotic. The ordinary player profile does not get this rider.
fields.Acquisition: Sister Clara in the House of Healing.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
